name: MVGS (Multi-view-regulated Gaussian Splatting)
definition: A plug-and-play optimization method that improves Novel View Synthesis performance for existing Gaussian-based methods by constraining the optimization of 3D Gaussians with multi-view information.
summary: MVGS is a plug-and-play optimization method that improves novel view synthesis by constraining 3D Gaussian optimization with multi-view information, cross-intrinsic guidance, and cross-ray densification.
